title: Protocol for Early Vigour QTL Mapping
author: Yumin Yang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgrnjv5e
materials: The QTL IciMapping Software version 4.1 was used for genetic linkage map construction and QTL mapping. http://www.isbreeding.net/software/?type=detail&id=18 The location of SNP marker was aligned according to the physical map of Ae. tauschii AL8/78 for D genome. QTL analysis for the measured traits under the five different environmental conditions were performed using the inclusive composite interval mapping (ICIM) option. Significant LOD threshold was determined by 1000 permutations and P=0.05.

steps.title: Establish Field Trials
steps.instruction: Plant the RILs (Syn79 x Syn80, 230 SSDs F9) and parents in randomized complete blocks with three replicates.

substeps.instruction: Create plots consisting of five 1.5 m rows spaced 0.5 m apart.
At the two-leaf stage, retain only ten evenly distributed plants per row for further growth.
Apply common wheat production field management practices.

steps.title: Collect Plant Samples
steps.instruction: Randomly select 10 plants per plot with whole tissues (root and shoot), avoiding plants at the ends of each row to minimize edge effects, and place them in paper bags.

steps.title: Measure Phenotypic Traits
steps.instruction: Measure plant height (PH), tiller number (TN), and shoot fresh weight (SFW) within 12 hours of sampling.

substeps.instruction: Calculate PH and TN as the mean of the 10 plants.
Cut off the roots of the 10 sampling plants.
Measure SFW as the mean shoot fresh weight of the 10 plants.

steps.title: Determine Shoot Dry Weight
steps.instruction: Dry the shoots to determine shoot dry weight (SDW).

substeps.instruction: Place the shoot in one drying oven for 10 minutes.
Transfer to another drying oven and dry to a constant weight.
Collect 50 mg of plant fresh leaves.
Extract DNA using the NuClean Plant Genomic DNA Kit (CWBio, Beijing, China).
Quantify eluted DNA using a Qubit 4 Fluorometer (Life Technologies Holdings Pte Ltd, Singapore).
Normalize DNA using a 12-channel electronic pipette (volume range 10 to 100µL, Eppendorf, Hamburg, Germany) to the required genotyping concentration.

steps.title: Perform SNP Array Genotyping
steps.instruction: Execute SNP Array Analysis using the Affymetrix Axiom Wheat Breeder’s 15K SNP Genotyping Array via China Golden Marker Biotech Co Ltd.

substeps.instruction: Process and analyze fluorescence signals using Affymetrix Axiom Analysis Suite version 4.0.1.
Use ps-metrics for generating QC metrics.

steps.title: Analyze Phenotypic Data
steps.instruction: Perform statistical analysis of phenotypic data using the SPSS statistical package.

substeps.instruction: Calculate Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) based on the general linear model (GLM).
Estimate broad sense heritability (H2) using the formula: H2 = σ 2 g / (σ 2 g + σ 2 ge /n + σ 2 e /nr).
